'''Belukat''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Belukat system/Legends|Belukat system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] ruled by [[King/Legends|kings]]. It was said that Belukat's royal tomb builders were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the kings so that they would not be able to divulge the tomb's secrets to robbers.<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>
